HEEWON STYLE. Minimal iconic 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. Worm's-eye from dust: Kangrim braced holding a restive stallion's bridle on the Bukjeok felt-steppe, wind in mane, one tiny rider offering meat in the haze. LEFT sheet = mortal Kangrim face; RIGHT = northern-nomads rite board for felt, horses, steppe — ignore board faces. ONE device: the horse neck as a rising diagonal. He is still strong but the smile is gone. Day pale grass, crushed shadow under hooves. Hex #4a4a58 as steel bit catch. Full readable horse body. No text. No watermark.
